'''Saml al'Seen''' was a young [[Asha'man]] from the [[Two Rivers]] at the Black Tower with the rank of a [[Soldier]].

== Appearance ==
He was young, little more than a child and had dark hair.{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Saml al'Seen}}

== Activities ==
He watched the six [[Red Ajah]] members, when they came to the [[Black Tower]] to ask [[Mazrim Taim]] for permission to bond Asha'man as [[Warder]]s. His young age concerns the Aes Sedai, and they resolve not to bond any children. A fellow Soldier defends his presence in the Black Tower, calling him a fast learner.
